stories.title: Here Tomorrow creates community and support for people facing loneliness during the holidays
stories.summary: One Northeast Florida nonprofit is working to make sure no one has to face the feeling of holiday loneliness alone.

stories.title: 'I don't feel 100': Jacksonville native celebrates 100th birthday surrounded by generations of family
stories.summary: A Jacksonville native and Navy veteran turns 100 on Thanksgiving, surrounded by about 50 family members who traveled from across the country to celebrate his life.

stories.title: 1 dead, 6 injured in Thanksgiving shooting at teen party in Davenport Airbnb; sheriff blames negligence
stories.summary: Polk County Sheriff Judd says the alleged shooter was a gang member with 76 criminal and misdemeanor charges.

stories.title: Lanes closed on Blanding Boulevard over Cedar River as crews pull out car that fell into the water
stories.summary: A JSO spokesperson said officers are responding to a crash with injuries on the bridge, but had no further information available.

stories.title: Mother remembers son who died in St. Johns County motorcycle crash months after friend's death
stories.summary: Eddie Pustynovich would have turned 26 on Friday. His family is now facing their first Thanksgiving without him.

stories.title: Putnam County board approves fine schedule for at-large animals, dangerous dog violations
stories.summary: The fines would rise for subsequent violations of rules regarding at-large dogs, dangerous dogs and proper care.

stories.title: Jacksonville ACPS extends hours for the holidays as the shelter experiences overcrowding
stories.summary: Each Thursday and Friday through New Year's Day, Animal Care and Protective Services will stay open until 8 p.m. to allow for more adoptions.

stories.title: Thanksgiving travel picks up across Northeast Florida as drivers face delays
stories.summary: AAA says the worst time to travel today is from noon until 7 p.m. tonight.

stories.title: Flagler County seeks resident reports to determine the extent of flood damage
stories.summary: Flagler County Emergency Management has asked impacted residents to report flooding damage through the county's Public Damage Assessment Tool.

stories.title: Duval County jail inmate dies, JSO investigating
stories.summary: The Jacksonville Sheriff's Office says that the inmate was pronounced dead at a local hospital.

stories.title: Jacksonville to ring in the season with Holiday River Fest, Christmas boat parade and fireworks show
stories.summary: Christmas lights, boats, and fireworks: Holiday River Fest will begin Saturday at 5 p.m. along the Downtown Riverfront in Jacksonville.

stories.title: Major League Soccer rejects sale of the Jacksonville Armada
stories.summary: The team announced that a year-long plan to sell the team to Chris Campione was rejected by MLS.
